findings.text: Iteration cursor for radix tree chunk walks holds fields named index, next_index, tags and node, representing current position, resume position, tag accumulator and current node reference to allow chunk based traversal across calls.

Augmentation bundle for augmented red black trees groups three callbacks named propagate, copy and rotate that maintain derived subtree data across structural changes, with propagation bounded by an optional stop node.

Latch tree records use a doubled node array per entry and a doubled tree array per root guarded by a latch sequence counter, with an ops table providing less and comp predicates and a helper translating a tree node plus side selector back to its enclosing entry.
Chunk iteration control reserves the low nibble as tag selector mask with value 0x0f, uses bit 0x10 to request tagged only traversal, and uses bit 0x20 to request stop at first gap.

Red black color encoding represents red as 0 and black as 1, with helpers to extract color from packed parent field, test for red or black, and install parent pointer with or without preserving color.
Root tag shift is defined from the allocator flag bit shift, and tree declaration and initialization helpers delegate to the extended array initializer with caller supplied name and mask.

Each node packs parent pointer and color into a single word named __rb_parent_color with low bits reserved for color, so parent retrieval masks those bits away while color tests inspect them, keeping ordering links and balance state in one field.

Emptiness is signaled structurally: a tree with no root pointer counts as empty, and a node whose packed field points to itself counts as detached, with clear helpers installing the self reference and linked variants additionally nulling predecessor and successor links.

Cached roots maintain an extra leftmost pointer that always designates the smallest ordered node, updated on insertion when the new node sorts leftmost, advanced to the successor on removal of the current leftmost, and retargeted on replacement.

Slot reads are safe under read side protection with a retry check for transient internal markers, while the protected variant requires the caller to hold the tree spin lock as proven by lock tracking, separating lock free lookup from locked mutation paths.
Preload termination releases the per context preload reserve lock, ending a region where allocation failure is avoided by pre reserved nodes.

Tree mutation offers both plain and read copy update variants for linking nodes, finding entries, and swapping child pointers including root replacement, allowing concurrent readers during updates when the RCU forms are used.

Chunk iteration starts with resume position set to the requested start and current position cleared, fetches a chunk, then advances within the chunk skipping empty or untagged slots, honoring a contiguous stop request, with explicit retry resetting resume to current and lookup combining init plus a contiguous fetch.

Augmented removal unlinks the target while preserving order, copies augmentation data when a successor takes over, propagates derived values up toward the root, and returns a node hint when rebalancing of colors may still be required.

Exposed radix utilities cover slot dereference with and without locking, internal marker and exception pointer tests, preload release, iterator initialization and retry, chunk size query, slot advance, and loop macros for plain and tagged walks.

Ordered lookup entries provide extremes and keyed search, including leftmost descent, rightmost descent, exact match walk, first match among duplicates with successor chaining for duplicates, and a loop macro over all matches.

Ordered insertion entries descend by caller supplied ordering or comparison, link the new node as a leaf, rebalance colors, and optionally maintain cached leftmost or doubly linked ordering, returning existing node on duplicate or new leftmost marker on success.

Slot contents may be transient internal markers requiring a retry of the whole lookup, or encoded exception values signaled by low pointer bits, so callers must test before treating a slot value as a stable object reference.

Iteration guards against index wrap by clearing current position on init and against overrun by bounding chunk size to the resume window, while contiguous mode forbids crossing gaps by collapsing the window, preventing silent skipping of holes.

Callback generator macros build propagate by walking toward the root until stabilization, copy by duplicating augmentation fields, and rotate by refreshing both sides, with a max variant recomputing the maximum of local value and children.
Latch translation converts a red black node pointer plus side index into its enclosing latch entry, supporting dual version trees where each logical entry participates in two physical orderings.
